thread:
Aisha K.: hey folks, urgent — need to swap primary for the next ~3h due to a childcare emergency. @Ben L. can you pick up primary right now? there is an active pager (INC-1298).
Ben L.: I can, but I'm walking into a quick meeting. If it's noisy I'll need Carlos to be secondary for escalations. can you dump current state here?
Carlos M.: I can be secondary. what's the impact?
oncall-bot: [INC-1298] Latency spike detected in hosted-api (us-west-2). alert source: perf-probe-az1 x3. Pager triggered 1m ago.
Aisha K.: quick summary: p95 token latency jumped to ~700ms in the last 2min, and we're seeing intermittent 502s at the gateway. I rolled back a partial routing change but tails persist. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-high
Priya S.: quick handoff checklist: 1) transfer pager ownership 2) paste brief notes in-thread 3) update rota / notify SRE channel. i can patch the rota if you confirm who is primary.
Ben L.: i'm good to take it. can someone run the pd takeover command? i'm not at my laptop yet.
Aisha K.: running now:
```
/pd takeover --incident INC-1298 --assignee "Ben L." --note "midshift swap: Aisha -> Ben; Aisha offline for 3h"
```
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-1298 reassigned to Ben L. (action by Aisha K.).
Ben L.: got it, thanks. i'm now primary. joining the incident channel and opening the triage doc. @Carlos M. please watch the escalation queue; if error rate crosses threshold escalate to oncall-sre.
Carlos M.: watching dashboards: grafana://dashboards/hosted-api-latency, playing with a quick filter. i'll alert if gateway_errors > 5% for 2min.
Aisha K.: handoff notes pasted to incident: rolled back routing change cf-usa-west-2 v2 -> v1; partial rollback reduced errors by ~30% but p95 still high, suspect KV cache thrash on the dedicated pool. logs: https://logs.internal/query?inc=1298
Priya S.: rota updated: primary Ben L. until 1725530000 (3h). added note to ops/rotation. also added tag `handoff/emergency` to this thread.
Ben L.: ok plan: 1) validate rollback effect on canary nodes 2) check KV cache hit ratio and prefix eviction 3) if we don't see p95 < 300ms in 10m, escalate to full rollback and open a hotfix PR.
Carlos M.: running KV cache inspect now. sample command:
```
ssh ops@dedicated-01 "redis-cli --stat" | grep -E 'hits|misses|evicted'
```
Carlos M.: current numbers: hit_ratio ~ 72%, evicted keys spiked after the rollout — looks plausibly related. i'll keep probing.
Ben L.: nice. i've started a temporary rate-limit rule at the edge to reduce load on the pool (will expire automatically in 30m). monitoring impact.
Aisha K.: thanks all — i'm going offline to sort pickup. DM me for anything blocking/fatal. :pray:
oncall-bot: Note: last_message_ts updated to 1725503842. Incident INC-1298 state: acknowledged by Ben L., severity P1, watchers: Aisha K., Carlos M., Priya S.
Priya S.: if Ben needs a quick hand later i can shadow for the next hour. lemme know.
Ben L.: appreciate it, i'll ping if we need a second pair of hands. updating the incident doc and will post a short postmortem blurb after we stabilize. :white_check_mark:
